title: Normal quit offers waiting or attempting stop

steps.then: the Host answers terminateLater and shows its own dialog: Wait and Quit (default, P8), Stop and Quit, Don't Quit; it names the package and says stopping does not undo anything

steps.when: the user chooses Stop and Quit
steps.then: the stop attempt runs as in scenario 04 and Spinnet quits once the group is gone or after SIGKILL

steps.when: the user chooses Wait and Quit
steps.then: Spinnet quits when the task ends; the dialog stays to offer Stop and Quit
